projects.name: whatsup
projects.details: A lightweight package to return time-based greetings like "Good morning" or "Good afternoon" from a given datetime.

projects.name: linebot-nodejs-googlesheet
projects.details: Built a Node.js-based LINE Chatbot integrated with Google Sheets, enabling users to query and manipulate spreadsheet records seamlessly with structured visual feedback.

technologies.details: React, Flutter, Tanstack (router, query), React Native, Axum
Git, GitHub Actions, PostgreSQL, Redis, Vim, NeoVim, iTerm2

details: MassageHubs - Developed an app for purchasing gift certificates redeemable at four client branches in California; responsible for app development and system design.
EaseUp - Designed the system and developed customer and therapist apps for at-home massage services, matching clients with the nearest available therapist.

Mashares - Developed the UI and application-side logic for a co-working space booking app. Implemented features including news updates, meeting room reservations, 3D printer access, and various tools for users.
CaraTrip - Developed key features including authentication, user profiles, and route search using OpenRouteService API; customized map tiles to match the app theme.
Learned and applied Flutter and Dart fundamentals, including reusable components, grid layouts, state management, responsive UI design, and widget-based development through hands-on practice.
Developed an Apple Calculator clone using Flutter and Dart, implementing both the user interface and calculation logic to recreate the core functionality and design of the original application.

Developed a delivery application called Sushi Drop using Flutter, integrating OpenStreetMap and OpenRouteService API for map functionality, latitude/longitude coordinates, and route visualization. Implemented a basic real-time chat system using WebSocket, including image sharing.
Built a DrinksOnMe clone application using Flutter for the mobile frontend and Node.js with WebSocket for real-time communication, gaining practical experience in frontend-backend integration.
Implemented and practiced Flutter animations, gesture handling, and interactive UI components, including a Tinder-style swipe feature with left and right card interactions.
